# Subway Seat for Windows Terminal

Each flavor is a colour scheme plus a theme for the tab row and tabs. For light/dark following, use `"colorScheme": {"light": "Subway Seat Enamel", "dark": "Subway Seat"}` and the same shape for `theme`.

[Windows Terminal](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/windows-terminal/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | settings.json → merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | settings.json → merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | settings.json → merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays |
| All three | [`subway-seat-all.json`](subway-seat-all.json) | settings.json → merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file), after merging the `schemes` and `themes` entries:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat",
"profiles": { "defaults": { "colorScheme": "Subway Seat" } }
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file), after merging the `schemes` and `themes` entries:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat Tunnel",
"profiles": { "defaults": { "colorScheme": "Subway Seat Tunnel" } }
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file), after merging the `schemes` and `themes` entries:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat Enamel",
"profiles": { "defaults": { "colorScheme": "Subway Seat Enamel" } }
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
